uncertain_terms.note: The source document is largely in English already (mixed Arabic headings and English body); the English source text is kept verbatim and only the Arabic parts were translated.
Header table reads 'القوة المحطة' / 'التقنية الإجراء' – garbled; rendered as 'Power Station' / 'Technical Procedure' by inference from the MPIS header pattern.
Source 'on an annually bases' kept verbatim; 'bases' is presumably a typo for 'basis'.
The motor ratings are given as paired values (17/4.2 kW, 1435/330 rpm, 60/135 A, 34/20 A) with no explanation in the source; kept verbatim.
Source 'Mantle the motor after insulation drying' kept verbatim; presumably means 'Reassemble the motor'.
Source 'Cheek electric brake coil' kept verbatim; presumably a typo for 'Check'.
Source 'Collection the motor with gears and electric cables' kept verbatim; presumably means 'Reassemble/connect the motor'.
Source 'magnetic resistance' kept verbatim; presumably means the magnetic contactor.
'Suitable warning boards.' appears twice in the source safety list; reproduced as-is.
